english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for reminding someone or bringing something to their attention.
This is the all-purpose choice for giving someone a warning or calling a risk to their attention.
Use this when something helps bring a memory or fact back to mind.
Use 提醒 when alarming someone means alerting them to danger or reminding them to take necessary action.

examples.english: Thanks—you remind me that I have to hand in my homework tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 多謝你提醒我聽日要交功課。
examples.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 tai4 sing2 ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3

examples.english: I alert you to remember to bring an umbrella tomorrow.
examples.traditional: 我提醒你聽日記得帶遮。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tai4 sing2 nei5 ting1 jat6 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1

examples.english: This song helps jog my memory of my old life.
examples.traditional: 呢首歌提醒我以前嘅生活。
examples.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 tai4 sing2 ngo5 ji5 cin4 ge3 sang1 wut6

examples.english: You should alarm them about the slippery floor.
examples.traditional: 你要提醒佢哋地下好跣。
examples.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 tai4 sing2 keoi5 dei6 dei6 haa6 hou2 sin2
